title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow Futures Down Ahead Of 'Triple Witching' As Iran Warns Of 'Zero Restraint'—FedEx, Super Micro Computer In Focus - State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (ARCA:SPY)
summary: U.S. stock futures declined following a previous day's decline, with major indices dropping. FedEx reported better-than-expected results and raised its guidance, leading to a stock jump, while Super Micro faced a plunge due to charges against its co-founder. Planet Labs saw a soar in stock price after better-than-expected sales results, and Scholastic gained due to better-than-expected earnings and a buyback announcement.
sentiment_reason: The overall market sentiment is negative due to the decline in stock futures and major indices, offset slightly by the positive movements in individual stocks like FedEx and Planet Labs.
